question: Who of any station, even border-dwelling, is a knower, and what purifies place?
premises: lowborn or twice-born, child elder or even youth, border-dweller who knows
even of place, the sacred thread purifies
inference: Knowledge eligibility ignores station; the thread purifies even place.
plain_english: Lowborn or twice-born, child, elder or even youth — border-dwelling who is a knower; even of place, the sacred thread.
